summary: Bending Spoons S.p.A. furnished a Form 6-K reporting the October 2, 2026 close of two upsized add-ons to its existing senior secured term loan B facilities due 2031, following September 25 pricing. The US dollar tranche totals $1.25 billion and the euro tranche 395 million, both upsized from initial targets of $750 million and 250 million equivalent. Proceeds fund the agreed Miro acquisition, repay the drawn euro revolver, and serve general corporate purposes. JPMorgan arranged the dollar add-on; BNP Paribas, Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan and UniCredit led the euro add-on. Moody's upgraded to Ba3 and S&P to BB-. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; watch closing conditions and definitive documentation.
